text: Assignment due Friday, reply to Priya's email, reorganise my bookmarks, water the plant, maybe learn guitar someday

tasks.title: Assignment

tasks.reason: Plant hydration is a biological necessity, and allowing dehydration to proceed is unwise.

tasks.title: Learn guitar someday

tasks.excuse: The universe temporarily redirected my focus toward the subtle nuances of bureaucratic stamp placement.
